note: Server-driven style catalog. New packs/styles ship WITHOUT an app update. `thumbnail` points at a sample-face preview to upload under R2 vaultlens/previews/<id>.jpg (served via GET /vaultlens/preview/<id>). `negativeBase` is merged into every style's negative prompt.
